description: I came here at 11 after surviving a communist genocide. I lost my dad, three siblings, and grandparents. It wasn’t easy. I faced homelessness, hunger, and domestic violence, but this community got me through it.
paid_for_by: Paid for by the Committee to Elect Vanna Howard
title: Meet Vanna Howard | Democratic Candidate for the First Middlesex State Senate District — Vanna Howard for State Senate
